title: The Collapsing Family Tree
hook: You are directly related to every single human being alive today.
script: You are directly related to every single human being alive today. How far back must you look to find your shared ancestors? Go back forty generations and your family tree needs one trillion slots. That exceeds all humans who ever lived. To fit reality, every ancestral branch collapsed into one shared web. A few thousand years ago, every surviving parent became an ancestor to everyone. Did isolated island tribes escape this web, or is every stranger your blood cousin?

captions: How recently do you think our shared ancestors walked the Earth? Tell us your guess.
The math of pedigree collapse means human family trees overlap much faster than you think.
Every human lineage loops back into one recent branch.
